SELECT p.id AS port_id,
       p.tenant_id,
       p.mac_address,
       COUNT(i.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.subnet_id) AS distinct_subnet_count
FROM ports p
JOIN ipallocations i ON i.port_id = p.id
WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1
  AND p.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'
GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address
ORDER BY p.id;
